address: 541 S 500 E St, American Fork, UT 84003, United States

reviewText:
Finally tried this place today and I LOVED it!

Not only is it a cute restaurant, with excellent service. But, the chicken strips were tender and deliciously flavored, and so good.
The cornbread donut that came with the meal was yummy and a novel treat!

The sweet potato fries were amazing and could be dipped in their incredible marshmallow sauce or one of their fun savory sauces.

And the gourmet donuts were delicious and so impressive! My favorite was the biscoff 😍

They even have a drive-thru window.

I will definitely be coming back!
